skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skill.summary: Guides creation of distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces.
skill.author: anthropics

content.value_statement: Frontend work can look generic when design choices are vague. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to build polished interfaces with stronger typography, layout, color, and motion.
actual_capabilities: Defines a clear aesthetic direction before coding.
Guides production-grade HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue implementation.
Suggests typography, color, motion, layout, and background details.
Discourages generic AI aesthetics, repeated font choices, and cliche palettes.
Adapts implementation complexity to maximalist or minimalist design goals.
limitations: Does not include runnable templates or asset files by itself.
Does not perform accessibility testing; users must verify contrast and keyboard behavior.
Does not specify browser support or performance budgets.
Best results require clear product context, audience, and technical constraints.

use_cases.title: Product Page Direction
use_cases.description: Create a memorable product page with a clear visual point of view and polished interaction details.

use_cases.title: Application Interface Build
use_cases.description: Guide implementation of a functional app screen with cohesive layout, theme, and motion choices.

use_cases.title: Prototype Differentiation
use_cases.description: Turn a rough idea into a distinct prototype that avoids generic page patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Simple Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new frontend.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a polished web page for this product: [describe product]. Choose a clear aesthetic direction and implement the main screen.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this component for [audience]. Keep the same function, but improve typography, spacing, color, motion, and visual hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Create an App View
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and implement an app view for [workflow]. Include realistic states, dense information where needed, and cohesive interaction details.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Design Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a full visual concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a frontend concept for [brand or product]. Define the aesthetic direction, then implement a working interface that proves the direction.

output_examples.input: Build a dashboard for a logistics team that tracks late shipments.
output_examples.output: A working dashboard concept with dense status tables, alert states, restrained colors, and interaction polish for daily operations.

output_examples.input: Create a launch page for a new audio editing tool.
output_examples.output: A distinctive launch page with strong typography, audio-inspired visual rhythm, clear calls to action, and refined motion.

output_examples.input: Redesign a pricing card for a developer tool.
output_examples.output: A sharper pricing component with improved hierarchy, plan comparison clarity, hover states, and a more specific product tone.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product purpose, and technical stack before asking for implementation.
Ask for real interaction states, including loading, empty, error, hover, and responsive behavior.
Review accessibility, performance, and browser support after the visual direction is implemented.
anti_patterns: Do not request a generic modern landing page without product context.
Do not rely on decorative effects when the main workflow is unclear.
Do not skip testing for mobile layout, contrast, and keyboard access.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create distinctive frontend pages, components, and application interfaces with stronger visual direction.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it generate working code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the assistant to implement working frontend code for the requested interface.

faq.question: Does it choose a design style?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks the assistant to commit to a clear aesthetic direction before coding.

faq.question: Is it limited to one framework?
faq.answer: No. The skill mentions HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend options.

faq.question: What should users provide for best results?
faq.answer: Users should provide the product purpose, target audience, technical constraints, and any required workflows.
